html:
A courtship gathering of the Wodaabe, a group of Fula cattle herders, held at the end of the rainy season in Niger and Chad, in which young men in make-up and finery dance to be chosen by young women.

The men paint their faces, stress white eyes and teeth, and dance for hours in a line, while women judge their beauty and charm. It takes place at gatherings such as the Cure Salee near In-Gall, when herders bring their cattle to salt pastures. Photographs of it are among the most familiar images of the Sahel. Drought and insecurity have made the gatherings harder to hold. See also Niger's herders.
